Elena / team — thanks for the detailed questions. I've updated the MAP (attached v1 -> v1.1) and below are the explicit bullets your legal/security team requested. Please confirm these are acceptable so we can lock the MAP and move to contracting: 

Agreed data handling & compliance bullets (to include in DPA / SOW):
- Deployment mode: Redwood Private (customer VPC) or Dedicated with VPC egress controls; no Redwood-hosted persistent PHI outside customer-controlled storage without explicit sign-off.
- Audit logs: Immutable request/response audit logs available; we support exporting logs to customer-owned S3 on write-once configuration. Timestamps are ISO8601 and logs are hashed (SHA-256) for integrity verification.
- Retention: Customer-configurable retention policies for logs and artifacts. NovaMed can set object lifecycle on your S3 bucket for 7 years; Redwood will not override.
- Purge: Scoped deletion API — Redwood will accept authenticated deletion requests tied to customer keys. Purge timeline: cache eviction immediate (<1h), async storage removal within 72 hours, and backup deletion coordinated (may take up to 30 days depending on backup cycles).
- Embeddings & model artifacts: Redwood does not persist embeddings derived from PHI in shared model indexes. Embeddings may be cached in-memory for inference; persistent storage of embeddings or fine-tuned artifacts from PHI requires explicit contractual permission.
- Evidence: SOC2-summary.pdf (attached) and additional evidence available on request under NDA.

Milestones & next steps (updated):
- Technical Q/A with Ben: schedule by 2026-03-31 — Ben to confirm availability.
- Finalize MAP language for legal: target 2026-04-07 — Karthik to push updated MAP v1.1 (attached)
- Commercial & PO estimate: 2026-04-02 — Marissa to share pricing and Dedicated sizing
- Legal redline: 2026-04-14 — Elena/procurement to circulate redline
- Sign: 2026-04-30

Please reply with a quick ACK or any redline text you want in the DPA bullets above. If accepted, I'll tag this as agreed milestones in the MAP and mark Responsible parties accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.
